name: Sachi House: Ojima Tokyo
subtitle: 3LDK Family House • Park Front • Direct to Shinjuku
description:
Located in Ōjima, Kōtō-ku, Tokyo, perfect for 2–8 guests. Just around 8 minutes’ walk to Ōjima Station, one train go straight to Shinjuku (18min by express train and 26min by local train). A large park in front of the house, with swings and slides is right in front — great for families. Fully equipped with IH kitchen, 140L fridge, microwave, rice cooker, 32″ smart TV, air conditioner, and dining table.

🏠 Clean and Spacious House
・A fully renovated 3LDK (~60㎡) house exclusively for guest use.
・Accommodates up to 7 guests with three bedrooms.

🚉 Convenient Location
・Just a 8-minute walk from Ojima Station on the Toei Shinjuku Line.
・Only 2-minute walk to the traditional shopping street (Sun road Nakanohashi)
・Conveniently located near convenience stores, supermarkets, drugstores, and various restaurants.

🛏️ Comfortable Sleeping Arrangements
・Each bedroom is furnished with beds and mattress to ensure a relaxing sleep.

【Family-Friendly Amenities】
・Baby chair are available at no extra cost.
・Youtube connected with TV are provided for entertainment.

📶 Unlimited High-Speed Wi-Fi
・Enjoy free, high-speed Wi-Fi suitable for streaming videos without interruption.

💻 Remote Work Ready
・Equipped with a dedicated desk, chair for remote work.
・High-speed Wi-Fi is provided for seamless online activities.

🛋️ Dining & Kitchen
・Dining table with 4 seats and 1 bench and 1 baby high seat.
・Fully equipped with a refrigerator, microwave, rice cooker, and other kitchen appliances.
・General tableware and cooking utensils are available.
・A television connected to Youtube and internet.

🛏️ Bedrooms
・Bedroom 201: Two Semi-double beds, futons, air conditioning, and one electric fan, and working desk/chair
・Bedroom 301: One Semi-double bed, futons, air conditioning and one electric fan.
・Bedroom 302: One double bed, air conditioning, working desk/chair.

🧺 Laundry Room
・Washing machine at no extra cost. Dry on balcony or use coin laundry nearby.

🧼 Bathroom Facilities
・Washroom: Independent washbasin with a hairdryer.
・Shower Rooms: located on the 1st floor.
・Features automatic water heaters for easy hot water access.
・Body soap and shampoo are provided.

🚽Toilets: Located on the 1st floor, equipped with bidet and seat warming functions.

🧴 Amenities
・Face towels and bath towels are provided for each guest. Extra set will be charged for 300 JPY. Please contact to the host in advance.
・Body soap, shampoo, and conditioner are available.
・Laundry detergent are provided.

🚭 Smoking Policy
・Smoking is prohibited indoors, limited outdoors. Thank you very much for your understandings and your cooperation.

🔑 Guest Access
Guests have exclusive access to the entire house and all amenities.

📄 Additional Information
For non-Japanese guests, passport information is required prior to check-in.

⏱️ Approx. 80–90 minutes

manual.title: Trash Separation
manual.content:
🗑️ Burnable Waste (Combustible Trash)
　✔ Food waste, paper, tissues, plastic bags
　❌ No cans, bottles, or glass
　➡ Put in the Burnable Waste bin

🥫 Recyclables (Cans & PET Bottles)
　✔ Aluminum cans, glass bottles, PET bottles
　❌ No plastic containers (except PET bottles)
　➡ Please rinse, remove caps and labels before disposal

manual.title: Hot Water Panel
manual.content: Press the "Power" button on the wall panel in the kitchen. Set temp to 38°C before using the shower.

manual.title: Air Conditioner
manual.content: Remote is on the wall. "Reibo" is Cooling (Blue), "Danbo" is Heating (Red). Please turn off when leaving.

manual.title: Checkin Process
manual.content:
1️⃣ Open the cover
2️⃣ Enter the PIN code provided by the host
  If incorrect, press “C” to reset
3️⃣ Turn the knob to the right
4️⃣ Open the key box and take the keys
5️⃣ Use the keys to open the sliding door

manual.title: Microwave Usage Guide
manual.content:
1. Start Cooking
- Press Start to begin.
- The screen shows the remaining time.

2. Pause / Stop
- Press Stop/Cancel to stop when needed.

3. Remove Food
- Use oven mitts if the food is hot.

4. Cleaning
- Wipe the inside with a damp cloth after use.

⚠️ Safety Tips
- Do not put metal or aluminum foil inside.
- Be careful when heating liquids.
- Do not block air vents.

💡 Use Tip
- If the microwave doesn’t start:
  Open and close the door → Press Cancel → Try again.

manual.title: Rice Cooker Guide
manual.content:
1. Measure Rice
- Use the cup. Wash until water is clear.

2. Add Water
- Fill to the marked level.

3. Choose Mode
- Press Menu (メニュー) and select rice type.

4. Start
- Press Start (炊飯).

5. Finish
- Auto Keep Warm (保温).

6. Stop / Reset
- Press Cancel (とりけし).

7. Reheat
- Use Reheat (再加熱) if needed.

⚠️ Tips
- Do not open lid while cooking.
- Be careful of hot steam.

manual.title: Washlet (Toilet) Usage Guide
manual.content:
1. Start
- Press Rear (おしり) for rear wash.
- Press Soft (やわらか) for gentle wash.
- Press Bidet (ビデ) for feminine wash.

2. Adjust
- Use + / – to change water pressure.
- Use ◀ ▶ to adjust nozzle position.
- Set water temperature if needed.

3. Stop
- Press Stop (止) to stop washing.

💡 Tips
- Press Stop if unsure.
- Nozzle cleans automatically.
